response.query: How should we design sample size and power calculations for cluster-level interventions measuring provider behavior and patient-level clinical outcomes?
response.answer: For cluster-level interventions, use intracluster correlation coefficient (ICC) to adjust sample size and power calculations. Consider cluster size and expected effect size. Use software like G*Power for precise calculations.

results.title: Visualization of large-scale user association feature dat... - De Gruyter
results.content: # Visualization of large-scale user association feature data based on a nonlinear dimensionality reduction method. Visualization of large-scale user association feature data based on a nonlinear dimensionality reduction method. This study proposes a large-scale user association feature data (LSUAFD) visualization study based on nonlinear dimensionality reduction methods to address the complexity and high-dimensional issues of data. Section 3 introduces the design of the NLDR-based LSUAFD visualization platform, including platform architecture and functional module design, as well as the implementation of dimensionality reduction algorithms combining PCA, t-SNE, and LargeVis. Section 4 verifies the platform’s functionality through the testing of functional modules and data dimensionality reduction (DDR) modules. Therefore, in this study, the LSUAFD visualization platform combines three different dimensionality reduction algorithms: PCA, t-SNE, and LargeVis. Among them, PCA is used for its efficiency in processing large amounts of data, while t-SNE and LargeVis are advanced NLDR algorithms that can accurately reveal the inherent correlations in HDD while maintaining the data structure [19:29–41.10.3390/jimaging6050029Search in Google Scholar.
